build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates two ball puzzles with static bar blockers and baskets
create_element_with_ball: create a ball and blocker element using tilted static bars and a dynamic handle bar
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_relationships: update the task to require two balls touching using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS for two ball puzzle categorization
